title: feat(enter): one-off event promo codes that grant Quest Pollen
author: Drjacky

gist.summary: Added one-off event promo codes that signed-in users can redeem from the Quests overview for Quest Pollen. Admins create a code through POST /api/admin/promo-codes with an event ID, title, Pollen amount, required maximum redemption count and expiry; codes expire after 1 minute to 30 days, and amounts use the quest-grant reward cap. POST /api/account/promo-codes/redeem accepts codes regardless of case, dashes or spaces, but requires a dashboard session; API keys receive 403. Each redemption is credited through the existing reward ledger, appears in rewards history and is limited to once per GitHub identity, even if the account is recreated. Event IDs provide ledger attribution for counting redemptions and Pollen granted. Unknown and expired codes share a 404 response; repeat redemption returns 409. This first version does not include an admin UI, anonymous redemption, CSV reporting or referrals.

image.prompt: In a cozy garden hackerspace, Polli enters a short event code at a retro Quests terminal while a single lime green (#ecf874) Pollen flower blooms beside the rewards ledger. Polli, the main character, is a cute pixel art bee mascot with a yellow body and dark brown horizontal stripes, small black legs, two black antennae, black vertical oval eyes, bright pink rectangular blush marks on cheeks, a small happy smile, and small rounded light blue translucent wings; she is small-to-medium in the scene, wearing a tiny event badge, in strictly pixel art style, never realistic, with cozy pixel art, 8-bit aesthetic, soft pastel gradients, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes and a warm cream background.
